description: Deception-as-form: every signal lies about itself. The loudest hit hides inside the quietest section, the key changes its mind every thirty seconds, the tempo sags and recovers, the floor drops out anywhere instead of after peaks, and the track ends loud and dark on a pitch a semitone off home. No climax, no fade, no resolution - and the lyrics may be the transcriber hallucinating.
name: deceptive_perceptions

sections.name: Threshold
sections.notes: Near-silence opening (-28.7dB). No detectable pulse until ~0:16. Let the listener doubt whether the track has started.

sections.name: First arc
sections.notes: Long first statement, F minor. Build to a peak at 1:40, pullback with dips to -20.9dB, rebuild to -4.9dB at 3:25. Flip the mode F min -> F maj at 2:00 on the same root. Climb in steps, never a smooth ramp.

sections.name: Abyss + slam
sections.notes: The floor falls out (-25.9dB), then the loudest hit in the track arrives as near-pure sub-bass (centroid 444Hz) - a detonation under the silence, not a drop. 22.1dB swing in 15 seconds. This is the track's single most violent gesture; place it inside the quiet, not at a climax.

sections.name: Middle (relative oscillation)
sections.notes: Opens with a second dip cluster (-22.2dB), then the sustained E minor <-> G major relative major/minor oscillation, one side per ~30s for 2.5 minutes. The mode ambiguity IS the section - do not resolve it into one key.

sections.name: Interlude (sub drop)
sections.notes: 10.6 seconds. The top end leaves entirely - sub alone (centroid 594Hz, rolloff 1107Hz, ZCR 0.011). A breath of pure low end before the second stretch.

sections.name: Second stretch
sections.notes: Brightest ZCR in the track (0.222 at 8:50), but the floor still drops out (-20.7dB at 9:15). Peaks at -5.4dB around 10:20. Never let it feel safe.

sections.name: Dark interlude
sections.notes: Second sub-surface passage: centroid 511-942Hz, rolloff 832-1785Hz, RMS down to -18.9dB. Short, dark, and quieter than the interlude before it.

sections.name: Final stretch
sections.notes: Key wanders at low confidence - let the harmony stay unresolved and unplaceable. Loudest sustained passage so far (mean -8.8dB in the last minute, peak -5.2dB at 13:35). The track gets louder as it goes; do not wind down.

sections.name: Ending (loud dark stop)
sections.notes: Final 10 seconds hold -6.3dB mean while the spectrum collapses below 700Hz rolloff - loud AND dark at once. Hard stop at 850.5s on F#, a semitone off the F-minor home. No fade, no tail, no resolution. End loud, end dark, end wrong.
